description:
`http-relay` forwards authenticated UnitySVC gateway calls unchanged to an HTTP endpoint you own, swapping svcpass credentials for upstream credentials.

Relaying to your own endpoint means UnitySVC never stores what passes through and takes no commission on it. `http-relay` is a multi-channel service: the free `byok` channel forwards every call to one endpoint you store once as customer secrets, while the metered `plus` channel lets you run many relays under a single account — each enrollment binds its own upstream `base_url` and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` URL. The relay accepts any request format and forwards it byte-for-byte, so whatever your upstream speaks works. See “How to use this service” for both channels, credential handling, and code examples.
name: http-relay

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own endpoint
